Tutorial:

A) Connecting to the Ethereum blockchain:

1. Download the Metamask extension for your browser

:  
Download Metamask

2. Create a Metamask account.

B) Platform usage:

1. As a Buyer:

1.1. Marketplace section:

  • Select the class of data and fill the boxes with the features of interest.

  • Click the "Buy" button in one of the resulting items. A metamask popup should appear.

  • Click the "Submit" button for the transaction completion.

Note: The Data Owner will have up to 4 days to submit the dataset decryption keys.

1.2. Profile section:

  • Request Data Owner status: Click the "Request" button and submit the transaction with Metamask.

  • Download file: Click the "Private Key" button and paste your private key from Metamask (Go to Account Options - Account Details - Export Private key). Then click the "Download file" button.

  • Amount recovery: Click the "Amount recovery" button if the Data Owner doesn't upload the dataset decryption keys after 4 days.

    Note: In the case the Data Owner has submitted the decryption keys but these are invalid, once you click the amount recovery button the withdrawal period is restarted in order to give the chance to the Data Owner to upload the keys again.

  • Allow withdrawal: Click the "Allow withdrawal" button if the decryption keys uploaded by the Data Owner are valid.

    Note: After the withdrawal period and if the Data Owner has submitted the decryption keys, he will be able to withdraw the amount deposited in the contract, independently if the keys are valid or not. If the keys are not valid proceed as described in : "Amount Recovery - Note"

2. As a Data Owner:

2.1. Profile section:

  • Upload dataset: Select the class of data and fill the boxes with the features of interest. Once done, introduce an alphanumeric seed in the proper box and click "OK". The upload file section should be displayed after the seed is submitted.

    Note: Write down the decryption key and IV shown in the screen once the upload is completed.

  • My Datasets:
  • My Deals:
